questions.stem: In the carbon cycle, carbon is constantly recycled. Which statement best describes why this is important?

options.text: It creates new carbon atoms for organisms to use
It ensures carbon is available for new organisms to build organic molecules
It prevents too much oxygen building up in the atmosphere
It stops plants from photosynthesising too quickly

questions.explanation: The carbon cycle ensures that carbon atoms are recycled between the atmosphere, living organisms, and the Earth. This makes carbon continuously available for organisms to build essential organic molecules.
